author: Lokigh
body:
Age: 16, Birth date 30/05/00
 
Timezone: GMT, I live in London 

Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes/No: Yes! I am on it right now whilst writing this application as a matter of fact :)

Do you have access to Skype? Yes/No: Yes! Skype: roger.moore520

Do you have access to a recording software? Yes/No: Yes! Fraps :)

Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers? I have had staff on two other servers, although these were both a long time ago. One helper rank, one mod rank. First server was called toxicmc and had a few hundred players, and the other was a prison server. I enjoyed my time as staff and learnt a lot.

What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating?

My biggest weakness is the fact I enjoy playing the game as much as possible, this may hinder my spectating of hackers although I believe that by playing I will be able to connect to the community better than just sitting in spectator the whole time. My biggest strength would be my activity- I am able to play daily. This is especially good as I commonly find myself playing at times with no staff members on. Therefore, by being staff I will be able to ban hackers (etc) during these times- which will hopefully boost the player count at some points in the day.

How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team?

To reiterate what I said before, by being an active member I believe I can help the staff team, as well as the server in general. Also, I can help the staff team by contributing a positive attitude on communication platforms and ingame. 

What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why?

A leader has a variety of qualities in my opinion, these prominently being kindness, confidence, innovation.. but also an aspect of sternness and desire to 'get the job done.' I wouldn't consider myself a leader of sorts but I believe I can exhibit the qualities of a leader in certain situations.

What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?

Well first of all, I am a very old player in the terms of being an old player than still plays the server regularly. Therefore, I believe this gives me more knowledge of avicus and how the server works, but also the community and how players commonly act ingame. Also, I am willing to sacrifice my time in order to help the maintain the server which I believe a lot of other players wouldn't bother to do. 

What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?

By knowing the community well and having been around then for a long time, this really helps you connect with these players. Whenever interacting with people in the community you should usually be friendly and show interest in each person; in order to make them feel at home and in a nice environment when they are playing the server. I believe suffice both the descriptions I just provided.

How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)? 

Most of my free time, which is generally everyday of the week for a few hours and more on weekends unless I happen to be busy with exams for example. 

You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do?

Well, as I have seen various Junior mods do, I would freeze the player everytime I see them backing (if I have sufficient reasons to believe they are hacking) and then would contact a senior staff member to perm and/or ip ban them.

Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on Teamspeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do?

Both the other staff member or ask to speak to them in another channel and ask them to stop annoying the people in the team channel, in a friendly way; which will likely make them stop in most cases. However, if they continue to pursue their behaviors I would report them to a more senior staff member than them (unless it is an admin that is abusing then what can I do xD.)

A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realise that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do? 

This question depends on the case. If the player was blatantly ruining the game but the evidence happens to be lost (for example someone flying around the map and destroying the mons,) I would have to persist with the ban. However, if it was a less serious ban and I couldn't find the evidence unless there were multiple competent witnesses who could provide testimony to the ban. Otherwise I would have to unban them (innocent until proven guilty, right?)

You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?

This is clearly not allowed on the server as anything that is only visible to staff is clearly confidential. I would swiftly report them to senior staff. 

One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do?

Ask the other mods what their opinions are on the matter and if there are a significant amount of people who said they did not agree with the decision too, I would consult a senior staff member about it. 

What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you?

This is my third application on avicus for staff member and I believe I made my first just before I turned 15. After all these attempts to actually get Junior mod at least would be a great success for me personally and I would be delighted. Third time lucky, right? :) haha.

How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you?

As a older avicus player I have seen many players come and go, and I feel really connected to the avicus community. Avicus is amongst my favourite hobbies and I would hate to see the server go. 

Do you speak any other languages than English?

Unfortunately not.

Do you have anything else to add to your application?

Summing up my application, I believe that I would really help avicus if I were to become a staff member due to a combination of my passion I have for the server, my knowledge of the server and the community and my activity on the server. I hope you consider my application seriously as I would really love to be part of the team. 

Thanks for your time

-ya boi lokigh
(P.S ily)
